[[File:Shiny_Sideshow.png|thumb|right|200px|A "shiny" clone trooper]]
{{Quote|Congratulations. You're not shinies anymore.|[[Clone Captain/Legends|Clone Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|Rex]], to Echo and Fives|audio=NotShiniesAnymore-Rookies.flac|<ref name="Rookies">{{TCW|Rookies (episode)}}</ref>}}
'''Shinie''' or '''shiny''' was a [[List of phrases and slang/Legends#S|derogatory term]] used by experienced [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]], like [[Clone Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|Rex]], when referring to rookie clone [[Private/Legends|privates]], whose armor was still pristine. [[Clone cadet/Legends|Clone cadets]] were also referred to by this name. [[Hevy/Legends|Hevy]], [[Echo/Legends|Echo]], [[Droidbait/Legends|Droidbait]], [[Fives/Legends|Fives]], and [[Cutup/Legends|Cutup]] were some notable shinies stationed on a [[Rishi Station/Legends|remote outpost]] in the [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]] system. However, after an [[Defense of Rishi Station/Legends|attack]] from [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy]] forces, Droidbait, Hevy, and Cutup perished, and Echo and Fives were inducted into the famed [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]], leaving their "shinie" status behind. On [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]], Sergeant [[Kano]] told his new squad that they were no longer "shinies."

==Behind the scenes==
Although most sources spell the term "shinie," the [[Wikipedia:Nintendo DS|Nintendo DS]] version of ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Republic Heroes]]'' spells it "shiny."
